note: Local paths on this machine. Adding a process node is an edit to this file plus `sync.py --to <repo>` and a flow_policy.json in the new repo.
renamed: ADR-0001: all three process ports moved to spec2si-<process> on 2026-08-20, together with SPEC2SI_FLOWKIT -> spec2si-flowkit. These are LOCAL paths only; the GitHub repos still carry the old names, so `git remote -v` disagreeing with this file is expected until they are renamed there too. The standing rule this file learned the hard way: record where a repo IS, never where it is going -- an intended path makes --check-all report MISSING on a repo that is perfectly healthy, which is the cry-wolf failure the LF pin exists to prevent.
